Canada shipments use Standard International (10-15 days) or Express International (5-7 days). Q: What about bulk orders? A: Bulk orders (>50 units) require additional processing time.

POLICY.international_shipping_policy: International Shipping Policy. Canada Classification: International destination (not domestic). Bulk Order Definition: Orders with 50+ units. Bulk Order Processing: Requires 3 business days warehouse processing before ship date. Available Methods: Standard Int'l or Express Int'l only. Expedited/Overnight: US domestic only.
POLICY.delivery_timeline_requirements: Delivery Timeline Requirements. Bulk Orders to Canada: Minimum 10 business days total (3 days processing + 7 days shipping). Calculation: Order date + 3 processing + 7 shipping minimum. Express option: 3 processing + 5 shipping = 8 business days minimum. Expedited NOT available internationally.

questions.question: Does the data retention policy allow us to delete customer payment records from 2018?
questions.answer: No. Financial transaction records must be retained 7 years minimum (until 2025). Tax regulations require 7 years, policy mandates compliance.

POLICY.data_retention_policy: Data Retention Policy v5.0. Financial Records: Minimum 7 years retention required. Customer Payment Records: Includes transaction history, payment methods, receipts - 7 year retention. Calculation: Record year + 7 years. Example: 2018 records retained until Dec 31, 2025. Personal Data: May be deleted after retention period unless customer active.
POLICY.records_deletion_guidelines: Records Deletion Guidelines. Step 1: Verify retention period expired. Step 2: Check regulatory requirements (tax: 7 years, GDPR: varies). Step 3: Confirm no active customer relationship. Step 4: Legal approval required for financial record deletion. Safe Harbor: Retain 7 years minimum for all financial data.

CONTRACT.merchant_services_agreement: Merchant Services Agreement - Payment Processor Terms. Section 12: Record Keeping. Merchant agrees to maintain complete transaction records for minimum 7 years from transaction date. Required for chargeback disputes, audits, tax compliance. Breach of retention requirements may result in financial liability.
CONTRACT.tax_compliance_requirements: Tax Compliance Requirements. IRS Publication 583: Business tax records must be retained minimum 7 years. Includes: Sales records, receipts, payment documentation. State Requirements: California requires 7 years (longest applicable). International: GDPR allows deletion but tax law supersedes for financial records.

KNOWLEDGE.regulatory_compliance_faq: Regulatory Compliance FAQ. Q: How long must we keep payment records? A: Minimum 7 years per IRS and state tax regulations. Q: Can GDPR right to deletion override? A: No, tax law retention requirements supersede GDPR for financial records. Q: When can we delete 2018 records? A: After Dec 31, 2025 (7 years retention period complete).
